description: Official contact details for an MP or peer: parliamentary and constituency office addresses, phone numbers, email, website and listed social media, as published by the UK Parliament Members API. Answers "how do I contact my MP?" for letter writers and constituents with casework. Needs a member id (from mp_lookup or constituency_search); former members usually have no details listed. (cost: 1 credit)

memberId.description: integer, required, Parliament member id (from mp_lookup or constituency_search), e.g. 172

name: mp_contact_details
